title: .kritika.yaml
description: A repository's kritika configuration, read from the merge base. See https://kritika.home-operations.com/repository-config/.

enabled.description: false stops reviews, follow-ups and indexing. true cannot turn a disabled repository on.

model.description: The model the default pass runs on. It replaces the admin's model, and with it the admin's agents that replace the default pass. An agent of review.agents without categories picks another model for some pull requests.

effort.description: How hard the review model, and the fallback that takes its step, reasons. It replaces the admin's value.

fixes.description: true requires a suggested fix on every finding. false cannot lift the admin's requirement.

approve.description: true approves a pull request whose review finds nothing at P0 or P1. With a confidence score, true approves one whose score reaches the threshold and whose risk is within confidence.risk. A later review that no longer allows it dismisses the approval. It replaces the admin's value. A block with when approves only a pull request that one of its conditions holds for, beside the admin's conditions.

when.description: Conditions, as a rule's. One of them must hold for a pull request to be approved. An approval of a pull request that they stop holding for is dismissed.

diagram.description: true has the summary draw the flow that the change adds or alters as a Mermaid diagram. It replaces the admin's value.

agents.description: Agents of the repository's own. An agent with categories reviews for them beside the default pass and the admin's agents. Under the name of an admin's agent, it only adds rules and skills to that agent. An agent without categories replaces the default pass when its conditions hold, and the first that holds does so. The file's agents of this kind replace the admin's, whole.

then.description: An agent without categories replaces the default pass: it needs a model and takes only name, enabled, model, fallback, effort and when.

name.description: Names the agent to comments, commands and the dashboard.

instructions.description: What a specialist reviews for, added after kritika's own instructions.

file.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, whose content is a specialist's instructions.

categories.description: The only finding categories that the agent can report. When written, the agent reviews beside the default pass. When unset, it replaces the default pass.

model.description: The agent's model. When unset, a specialist's model is the default pass's, as the agents picked it. An agent without categories needs one.

fallback.description: The model that takes a step that the agent's model fails. When unset, it is review.fallback's for an agent without categories, and the default pass's for a specialist, as the agents picked it.

effort.description: How hard the agent's models reason. When unset, it is review.effort's for an agent without categories, and the default pass's for a specialist, as the agents picked it.

paths.description: The changed files that a specialist reads, every one when unset. The specialist does not review a pull request that changes none of them.

when.description: Conditions as a trigger's, with paths and pr.lines, judged over the whole pull request: the agent runs only when one of them holds, and always without any.

rules.description: Checks a specialist makes, in place of the repository's, which are the default pass's.

skills.description: Skill scopes laid over the repository's for a specialist.

agent.description: Bounds of a specialist's agent, each part of it in a split review. They can lower the repository's bounds and never raise them.

timeout.description: A Go duration, such as 10m, at least 1s and at most 2h35m.

confidence.description: How a review is judged: a second model scores the reviewed pull request from 0 to 5.

model.description: The model that scores a reviewed pull request. It replaces the admin's model.

fallback.description: The model that takes the scorer's call when the confidence model fails. It replaces the admin's model.

effort.description: How hard the confidence model, and the fallback that takes its call, reasons. It replaces the admin's value.

threshold.description: The score that a pull request must reach to be approved and, with gate, for its commit status to pass. It replaces the admin's value.

gate.description: true fails the commit status under the threshold, so it can be a required check. It replaces the admin's value. A block with when gates only a pull request that one of its conditions holds for. Another pull request shows its score and passes.

when.description: Conditions, as a rule's. One of them must hold for a pull request to be gated.

risk.description: The highest risk that a change can be rated and still be approved. It can only lower the admin's value.

when.description: Conditions, as a rule's, beside the admin's. One of them must hold for a pull request to be scored. A pull request that they leave unscored is reviewed without a score and, where the admin asks for a score, not approved.

trigger.description: Which pull requests get a review.

include.description: Conditions that let a pull request in: it is reviewed when any of them holds, or the list is empty, and no exclude condition does. It must pass the admin's lists as well.

exclude.description: Conditions that keep a pull request out: it is skipped when any of them holds, whatever include says. A skip names the condition that held when it has a name.

ignore.description: Globs of paths that kritika leaves out of a review's context and of the index, added to the admin's. A pull request that changes only ignored paths is skipped.

summary.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, that replaces the summary comment's template. "" restores the built-in one where the admin set a template.

finding.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, that replaces an inline finding's template. "" restores the built-in one where the admin set a template.

rules.description: Checks the review makes, added after the admin's. A rule cannot reuse the id of an admin's rule.

id.description: Names the rule to the findings that cite it.

file.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, whose content is the check.

paths.description: Apply the rule only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the rule applies only when one of them holds.

context.description: Files that explain the code, added after the admin's.

paths.description: Name the file only when a changed path matches one of these.

skills.description: The repository's Agent Skills: folders holding a SKILL.md, read from the merge base. A review is offered each one's name and description and reads the skill when it fits.

paths.description: The directories whose folders each hold a skill. They replace the admin's. They are .agents/skills and .claude/skills when no one sets them, and an empty list turns skills off.

scope.description: Narrows when a skill is offered, by the skill's name. It is added to the admin's scopes, and a skill named in both takes this file's.

paths.description: Offer the skill only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the skill is offered only when one of them holds.

load.description: Whether a review the skill applies to is given its instructions in the system prompt, rather than its name to read with load_skill. Unset, a scope with paths or when gives them, and one with neither offers the skill by name.

tools.description: The tools that the repository's reviews can run, over the image's commands. These are packages of the aqua registry (https://github.com/aquaproj/aqua-registry), each named aqua:<package>, such as aqua:home-operations/flate, with the tag of the release to run. A tool installs on its first use. The runner first makes sure that the download matches the digest GitHub keeps of the release's asset, else the checksum file that the registry names. Only packages that download a release's asset or a file at a URL are offered. A package that builds from source is not offered. A package is also not offered when nothing published apart from its download gives a checksum for that download.

toolVersion.description: The tag of the release to run, such as v0.6.5 or kustomize/v5.8.3. A word with no digit, such as latest, is refused: a download URL that takes it reads as whatever is newest.

condition.description: One condition on a pull request, in trigger.include, trigger.exclude or a review.agents entry's when: expr, paths, or both, when both must hold. One with paths, or whose expr reads pr.lines, is judged once the pull request's diff is fetched.

name.description: What the condition is called where a skip or an agent names it. In a trigger list it is unique in the list, and cannot be one that an admin's condition has.

expr.description: A CEL expression over pr that says whether the condition holds. pr.lines is the lines the diff adds and removes, ignored paths left out.

paths.description: The condition holds only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: One condition on a pull request, in a rule's or a skill scope's when.

expr.description: A CEL expression over pr, as a trigger.include or trigger.exclude expression sees it, without pr.lines.

model.description: A <provider>/<model> reference, of a provider the instance or the account declares.

effort.description: A reasoning effort, lowest first, or "" to leave it to the provider. Every provider takes low to max. The Anthropic Messages API has no level under low and gets none and minimal as low.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root.

glob.description: A doublestar glob, such as docs/** or **/*.sql.
